---
description: Run a fresh-context Gate A critique of a system design.
agent: design-critic
---

Read `AGENTS.md`.

Review only the Change Brief/DoD, system-design artifact, and minimum authoritative evidence. Challenge boundaries, contracts, invariants, flows, failure/recovery, security/reliability/observability, compatibility, unknowns, and hidden implementation assumptions.

Return FND IDs classified BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / ADVISORY plus PASS/FAIL Gate A recommendation. Do not edit the design.
